name: Landwirt
intro: Für Bauer und Hof: dein Spruch, Name und Betrieb. Optional ein eigenes Foto hochladen – Trecker, Hoftier oder was auch immer – dann wird genau das gezeichnet.
variations:
central motif: a strong classic tractor on a field with wheat ears and a rising sun
central motif: a big combine harvester cutting a golden wheat field
central motif: a tractor pulling a loaded hay trailer at sunset
central motif: a vintage old-timer tractor with big rear wheels in front of a barn
central motif: a tractor with a plough turning dark soil, crows following
central motif: a round-baler and hay bales in a field
central motif: a forage harvester and a tractor with trailer side by side
central motif: a milk cow with a bell in front of a farmhouse
central motif: a pig and a rooster in front of a barn door
central motif: a modern tractor with front loader lifting a big bale
central motif: a slurry tanker on a green meadow with a red sun
central motif: a farmer walking the field and scattering seeds by hand - the WHOLE figure from head to boots, never a hand or arm on its own, tractor in the background
central motif: a farmer's silhouette leaning on a fence looking over his fields at dawn

fields.label: Adresse des Hofes (für die GPS-Koordinaten)
fields.hint: Optional – daraus werden automatisch die Koordinaten deines Hofes aufs Design gesetzt.

upload.label: Eigenes Foto (optional): Trecker, Tier vom Hof …
upload.hint: Lade ein Foto hoch (Trecker, Hoftier, Hofansicht …) – Otto zeichnet genau das als Motiv, ohne es zu verändern. Ohne Foto entsteht ein passendes Trecker-Motiv.

prompt:
Bold farming T-shirt print, portrait, isolated on a plain empty background.

Big lettering carries the main text, which reads exactly "{spruch}".
[[A small line reads exactly "{name}".]]
[[A curved line reads exactly "{hof}".]]
[[A small GPS-style coordinate badge reads exactly "{koordinaten}".]]

The central motif and the arrangement follow the variation given below - a different picture every time. Proud, rural, hard-working look.

Style: vintage rural screen print, thick outlines, warm earthy palette (green, mustard, rust, cream) plus one accent, halftone shading, no photorealism, no gradients.
